thesis: The podcast introduces a mini-series on the satellite economy featuring founders of Astronus and Stoke Space, focusing on the transition from a government-dominated spaceflight era to a private sector-driven industry. It highlights that Astronus aims to provide internet connectivity to the four billion people currently without access by partnering with various customers, while noting that 2022 was a record year for the space sector with 186 successful rocket launches.
